Subject: Post-demo: Buying committee recap & next steps

Thanks again for taking the time today — great conversation and appreciate the thoughtful questions. Below is a quick recap and proposed next steps so everyone is aligned.

Attendees (today's demo):
- Samantha Lee — Head of Data (primary product champion)
- Tom Gardner — CFO (economic buyer; watched live)
- Priya Shah — Head of Platform (technical evaluator)
- Chris Nolan — Security Architect (security reviewer)
- Marissa Cole — Account Exec (Redwood)
- Neha Kapoor — Solutions Engineer (Redwood)

Key highlights from the demo:
- Showed Redwood inference runtime: predictable latency for high-concurrency workloads, cost controls (batching + quantization profiles), and rollout/rollback flow.
- Priya liked the model pinning and KV cache features for their internal retrieval pipeline.
- Chris flagged SOC 2 evidence and SSO/SCIM flow as gating items for procurement.
- Tom called out unit-cost and predictable monthly spend as the deciding factor for Q3 budget.

Stakeholder map (as we understand it):
- Economic buyer: Tom Gardner (CFO) — budget approval and SOW sign-off
- Technical/eval owner: Priya Shah (Head of Platform) — performance and integration signoff
- Security/compliance reviewer: Chris Nolan — SOC 2, data residency, SSO
- Day-to-day champion: Samantha Lee — product requirements, success metrics

Proposed next steps / timeline:
1) Redwood to share SOC 2 summary + SSO integration doc by EOD tomorrow (attachment: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf).
2) Samantha & Priya to run a short perf checklist (we will provide a 1-week trial config and a suggested load profile).
3) Procurement: Aditya, can you share a standard mutual action plan and rough pricing band for 6–12 month reserved capacity?
4) Follow-up call with buying committee (Tom + Priya + Chris + Samantha) — propose Wed 6/17 10:00am PT.

Action owners:
- Redwood: Marissa/Neha — SOC2 doc, trial config, MAP draft
- Acme: Samantha/Priya — perf checklist, internal schedule with procurement
- Acme procurement: Tom — budget & timeline

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (high-level controls summary)

If that aligns, I can lock Wed 6/17 10:00am PT for a 30-min buying committee sync.

Thanks,
Marissa
